formativeFinding: The supplied official FBISE Grade XI framework lists Unit 5's four chapter outcomes B-29–B-32 as Summative. No separate formative theory SLO is listed among these four; do not treat adjacent Unit 4 B-28 or Unit 6 B-33 as Unit 5.
pbaSourceCaution: Official framework PDF page 27 states that summative PBA practical SLOs are not identified in the document and a separate practical list will be shared. This does NOT establish that Unit 5 has no practicals/PBA; check the relevant separate PBA list before making practical-assessment claims.

fullPaperStructure.caution: Model paper is full-grade, covers many content domains; do not infer 80 MCQs or 7+2 descriptive questions from Unit 5 alone.

chapterExerciseEvidence.scope: NBF original Unit 5 pp.85–87 exercises visually inspected for scope. Both Set A and Set B are newly authored source-mapped MCQ practice, not quoted textbook question copies.

assessmentPublicationGate: Use only B-29/B-30/B-31/B-32 for Unit 5 written summative theory selection; preserve cognitive A/A/U/A from official SLO table.
Check proposed questions against the NBF Unit 5 textbook (pp.77–87) and reject unsupported/out-of-unit content.
Independently solve and peer-review each candidate MCQ option and solution; avoid predictable key positions and source text errors.
Keep student-only question view separate from teacher answer/marking view; protect existing account/grade features.
For full-grade FBISE-style papers preserve the official boxed MCQ presentation and 50%/50% global structure; do not impose an 80-MCQ quota on a single unit.
Complete teacher academic and projector/mobile/print sign-off; verify separately issued PBA list where practical questions are involved.

For V50, keep original 16-question classroom practice clearly labelled provisional and ungraded, with answers fetched only by a separately accessed public teacher key; do not present a 16-MCQ paper as a full FBISE 80-MCQ examination.
Review Set B's zero-crossing signed-work graph, mixed applied and resistive forces, and variable-force trolley stimulus before approving any teacher key as a formal marking scheme.

V52 descriptive and numerical alternatives are UNGRADED Unit 5-only practice despite using a familiar seven-SRQ/two-ERQ 40-mark layout. Evaluate only one answer from A OR B for each question, with equivalent physically correct reasoning awarded appropriate marks.
